msg: O refresher é obrigatório? Quanto tempo leva? O almoço está incluído?
reply:
Great questions! Let me answer them one by one. 🌊

*Is the refresher mandatory?*
If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required to get back in the water safely. Very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master level) can be reviewed by a team advisor to see if it's needed. And if you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another center, that counts — you could dive directly.

*How long does it take?*
It's a 1-day activity, same-day round trip from Cartagena:
- Meeting at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.
- Speedboat to the Rosario Islands (approx. 1 hour)
- Pool session: theory review + confined-water practice
- 1 reef dive + surface interval
- Return to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.)

*Is lunch included?*
Yes! Lunch is included (rice with chicken or rice with vegetables), plus water all day and coconut candy between dives. If you have any food allergy, just let us know before the tour.

One note: after diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying (the refresher counts as 18 hours, since it's for certified divers).

Would you like me to help you set up the booking? 🤿

It also includes:
• Access to the PADI Rescue Diver online course
• Entry to Rosario Islands Natural Park
• Access to the hotel facilities during surface intervals
• Eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL

You'll also need:
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email.
• Prerequisite: holding the Advanced Open Water certification.
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in every plan.

Two-day courses (Open Water, Referral Course, Advanced) require accommodation on the islands: at least one night, the night of day 1 (there is no return to Cartagena on day 1). There is no option to commute from Cartagena on both days. Accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.

And how many people should I plan for? That way I can give you the exact price. 😊

msg: ¿A qué hora tengo que estar allá y qué debo llevar para las salidas de buceo?

¡Claro que sí! Te cuento los horarios y lo que debes llevar. 🕗

*Horarios:*
• Desde Cartagena: salida a las 8:00 a.m. desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita y regreso a las 3:00 p.m. (llegada aprox. 4:15 p.m.).
• Desde las islas: recogida en el hotel entre las 9:30 y las 9:45 (a las 8:00 en las especialidades y a las 7:30 el día 2 de algunos cursos).

Los horarios de salida y de recogida son fijos: no se pueden adelantar ni retrasar. Si necesitas un ajuste, lo revisa un asesor del equipo.

*Desde Cartagena:* Muelle de la Bodeguita, a 5 minutos del centro historico, a las 8:00 AM. Saliendo desde Cartagena no hay recogida en el hotel: cada cliente llega por su cuenta al muelle (el transporte terrestre hasta el muelle no esta incluido).

*Si ya estás en las Islas del Rosario:* Si el cliente ya esta en las Islas del Rosario y su hotel tiene acceso maritimo, la recogida y regreso en lancha estan incluidos sin cargo adicional.

*Qué llevar:*
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmacion.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en todos los planes.

msg: Eu pago em dólares? Tem desconto se eu reservar agora pelo site?
reply:
Yes! As an international client, you pay in *US dollars (USD)*. The website applies a *10% online discount* automatically when you book directly with us.

• 10% discount when booking online directly with us through our website, not through third parties like PADI. This is the standard online discount and is applied automatically when booking on the web.
• 10% discount for groups of 5 or more people, which stacks with the 10% online discount (20% total when booking online). Not applied automatically: the group must contact the team to apply it. It must be requested from the team BEFORE paying: if the group pays without having requested it, the discount is lost (it is not refunded afterwards). Applies to recreational diving, mini-courses and snorkeling; does not apply to PADI courses.
• 5% discount if the client brings their COMPLETE own gear (regulator, BCD, wetsuit, mask, fins, etc.), only for recreational diving and PADI courses: it does not apply to the mini-course or snorkeling, even with complete gear. It also does not apply if they only bring part of the equipment.
• Colombian clients and residents pay in Colombian pesos (COP). International clients pay in US dollars (USD). There is no special discount for being Colombian; the price is the same, only the currency changes.

International clients pay *100% by card on the website*. With a foreign card, use your passport as the ID document.

I recommend the *2 dives in 1 day* plan in the Rosario Islands. (If you'd rather a *multi-day package* of 3+ dives, just tell me.)

Has it been *more than 2 years* since your last dive?
